up: Retrieve the first 1000 activity rows meeting the following criteria: Target is the human single-protein CHEMBL1821 (Muscarinic acetylcholine receptor M4). Required output columns: assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value. Filters: exact standard relation ('='), non-null pChEMBL values. Ranking/Ordering: order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit: 1000 rows.
sql: SELECT ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, td.target_type AS target_type, td.tax_id AS tax_id, cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_type AS standard_type, a.pchembl_value AS pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1821' AND td.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN' AND td.tax_id = 9606 AND a.standard_relation = '=' AND a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id, ass.chembl_id LIMIT 1000
